newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse closes slightly up.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse closes slightly up.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange on Monday closed slightly up by 0.10 percent in lower trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 614.09 from 613.49 on Friday.
Trade volume was 754,020 dinars against 1.233 million dinars.
Detergents firm SPCD was up by 3.81 percent to 55.02 dinars. BTEI bank up 2.91 percent to 22.56 dinars and STB bank up 1.02 percent to 22.61 dinars.
Banque du Sud was down 2.98 percent to 29.26 dinars.
